title: Our Family Party
text:
I am twenty years old. My sister is thirty. My grandmother is seventy-five. Our family is big.

We have a family party every year. Forty people come to our house. My grandmother cooks food for everyone. The party is in June.

questions.text: How many people come to the family party?
Why is the grandmother probably important at the family party?
options: She is the youngest person there
She does not come to the party

questions.text: How does the narrator probably feel about the family party?

vocabulary.definition: the people you are related to, such as parents and children
a social event where people eat, drink and celebrate together
the mother of your mother or father

paragraph_translations: Mam dwadzieścia lat. Moja siostra ma trzydzieści lat. Moja babcia ma siedemdziesiąt pięć lat. Nasza rodzina jest duża.
Co roku mamy rodzinne przyjęcie. Czterdzieści osób przychodzi do naszego domu. Babcia gotuje jedzenie dla wszystkich. Przyjęcie jest w czerwcu.
